1. Melon Baller
Normal sudoku rules apply (fill each row, column, and 3x3 box with the digits 1-9 once each), and all clues are standard.
Cages: the sum of the digits inside each cage is equal to the small number in the top left corner.
Quadruple circles: a digit inside a white circle appears in at least one of the four cells surrounding that circle.
Very rough difficulty estimate: 3/10
Play online: SudokuPad [ https://substack.com/redirect/567d4f81-90a5-462d-a34b-077a0f9cccc8?j=REDACTED ] | unshaded [ https://substack.com/redirect/3a30414c-2baf-469a-a83a-01cc9c6cd542?j=REDACTED ]
New to variant sudoku? Check out these beginner-friendly guides to cages [ https://substack.com/redirect/02a391c1-7418-4c6a-ba65-3d96c7c53391?j=REDACTED ] and other popular rulesets [ https://substack.com/redirect/25c96841-1718-43f4-ad2b-b305683d9d14?j=REDACTED ].
The Artisanal Sudoku book [ https://substack.com/redirect/6f6b4c1d-361e-4d1e-ba4f-ebcb5cc0d8d8?j=REDACTED ] is available now! Order from Bookshop [ https://substack.com/redirect/ece29ec9-3ec7-4934-9f7b-bdc9b82add9e?j=REDACTED ], Amazon [ https://substack.com/redirect/3c833732-7736-41ff-86bb-8ff97a5b2cbd?j=REDACTED ], Barnes & Noble [ https://substack.com/redirect/04fc16ef-61b9-4e71-bd98-889ecd315175?j=REDACTED ], Target [ https://substack.com/redirect/450acd5c-673f-4526-9e55-5a321a825326?j=REDACTED ], Walmart [ https://substack.com/redirect/b08331dd-0ab7-4a5e-834a-b9a6ceb14a1c?j=REDACTED ], or your retailer of choice. If you’ve already bought a copy, please leave a rating and review to help others find it. Thanks!
2. Get the Horns
Normal sudoku rules apply (fill each row, column, and 3x3 box with the digits 1-9 once each), and all clues are standard.
Thermometers: digits on thermometers increase from the bulb.
German whispers: along green lines, digits differ from their neighbors by at least 5.
Very rough difficulty estimate: 6/10
Play online: SudokuPad [ https://substack.com/redirect/56d13411-5850-4d6c-8c60-2387536483a7?j=REDACTED ]
3. Water Lilies
Normal sudoku rules apply (fill each row, column, and 3x3 box with the digits 1-9 once each).
Clone lines: each blue line contains the same digits in the same relative positions.
Arrows: the sum of the digits along an arrow is equal to the digit in the connected circle, and these digits can repeat if allowed by other rules.
Quadruple circles: a digit inside a white circle appears in one of the four cells surrounding that circle.
Very rough difficulty estimates: 7/10, 5/10
Play online: SudokuPad [ https://substack.com/redirect/22e633ce-1247-4589-928f-03f00240ff5c?j=REDACTED ]

Killers in the dark [ https://substack.com/redirect/2f497a4a-d2d8-4d62-96d9-63301db3cb8c?j=REDACTED ], by Artham
This Hits Different [ https://substack.com/redirect/e3e0a7ad-32d4-49ed-8d0f-b9da045ad96c?j=REDACTED ], by Marty Sears
Thanks for subscribing to Artisanal Sudoku! Feedback is always appreciated, just leave a comment, reach out on Bluesky [ https://substack.com/redirect/cee3147a-cc8c-4879-8ad5-c6a7945fbe3a?j=REDACTED ], or reply to this email. If you liked these puzzles, you probably know someone else who’d like them too, so please spread the word. If you’re interested in submitting a puzzle, click here [ https://substack.com/redirect/f0412045-a143-4f7c-8e51-51642a80c92d?j=REDACTED ] for more information. And if you want to try more of my puzzles—many of which are tougher than the ones you’ll find here—check out my page [ https://substack.com/redirect/e8d7a200-6713-4f8c-a46c-b25652007ce0?j=REDACTED ] on Logic Masters Deutschland.
